title: JustinGuitar Practice Assistant: Build and Track Guitar Practice Routines (Free)
summary: This video is a practical walkthrough of the Practice Assistant feature in JustinGuitar’s platform. It demonstrates setting up a new routine, creating and editing practice items (for example 'Chord Changes' with a metric like 'Number of Changes'), and how to attach related links and statistics. The presenter shows item-level actions (edit, duplicate, archive) and adds items from the site (such as finger gym) into routines, then refreshes the page to reflect changes. The tutorial covers managing multiple routines, making one active, starting a practice session with a countdown, and using notes, a metronome with tempo and subdivisions, and end-of-minute alerts. It also explains how to record statistics (e.g., chord changes), switch between items mid-practice, import preset routines ( Blues Licks ), and view overall practice stats with graphs. A closing note highlights that the Practice Assistant is free and invites support via a donation button.
